CALL TO ORDER

At 2:02 PM, Chair Saro called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Councilmembers Present: Zendejas, Allen, Saro

Also present: Bo Martinez, Director of Economic Development, Atoy Wilson, Deputy City Attorney,
Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst, Karen Baldwin, City Clerk Analyst.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56543  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development and
  Opportunity Committee meeting of Tuesday, May 6, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Zendejas, seconded by Vice Chair Allen, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Zendejas, Allen, Saro
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  25-56544  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation by Economic Development
  regarding an update on Long Beach Workforce Innovation Network (LBWIN).

  A motion was made by Member Zendejas, seconded by Vice Chair Allen, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Zendejas, Allen, Saro
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None
